messages:
zoe_pm: kicking off a short thread to nail the rollout play for 'Graduated Throttles' — objective: avoid hard cutoffs, instead steer traffic through policy-driven fallbacks and tenant prioritization. need canary plan, flag lifecycle, AB/shadow mix, regional staging, and private-deploy rules. quick ideas?
marco_eng: propose a policy engine that evaluates signals (latency, queue depth, gpu_util) and returns ordered fallback actions per-tenant. fallbacks: throttle-rate, reduce-history, switch-model-small. flags hold ordered actions + ttl + tenant-priority.
dave_sre: safety rules: canary 0.2% x15m (sanity), then 1% x45m, then 5% x90m. auto-pause on 95p latency breach >2.2s or error_rate >0.7% in window. circuit-breaker should auto-unwind after cool-down or manual ack.
nina_data: telemetry contract: for each tenant/route capture latency_p50/95/99, fallback_action_rate, tokens_saved, churned_sessions, quality_delta_score. shadow policy: keep 5% shadow for 72h for trend detection, but for privacy-marked tenants drop shadowing.
larry_sales: enterprise requirements: default opt-out; but provide a signed opt-in for fallbacks. must surface expected degradation and estimated token savings in the tenant admin UI. also sales needs a PDF FAQ.
ella_priv: privacy note: shadow sampling must hash user identifiers and strip PII before storage. for on-prem customers, allow a local-only collector endpoint; do not export sampled prompts off-cluster without consent. add contract clause.
marco_eng: flag proto (pseudo inline): ```
name: graduated_throttle_v1
actions: ["throttle","trim_history","model_small"]
stages: [{pct:0.2,min_m:15},{pct:1,min_m:45},{pct:5,min_m:90}]
region_gates: {eu: true, na: true, apac: true}
tenant_overrides: {priority_map}
kill_switch: {region_level:true, cli:true}
``` keep it compact.
dave_sre: runbook ladder: 1) kill-switch region 2) set flag to previous stable 3) scale-up if capacity is the issue 4) engage customer ops. Add automated slack alerting to #incidents with top-10 impacted tenants.
nina_data: AB/quality checks: run paired AB for 24-72h, collect human evals on top diffs, compute quality_delta per-cohort. auto-fail if quality_delta > 0.6% on holdout. also track downstream error surfaces (NLP parse errors etc).
marco_eng: engineering caveat: trim_history needs KV-cache versioning; if we change mid-session, reconcile token offsets. plan: mark session_version in responses and on rollback stitch in a continuity message.
larry_sales: communications: one-week notice for tenants, preview mode in console (simulate expected token savings and latency change), and email template. enterprise customers should get opt-in form + SLA addendum if they want auto-fallbacks disabled.
ella_priv: legal addendum: require explicit consent for storing sampled prompts even hashed. for EU tenants ensure DP/contract alignment.
dave_sre: regional rollout order suggestion: EU -> NA -> LatAm -> APAC with 2h cool-downs between full-region ramps. keep canary slices independent per-region.
marco_eng: add metric gates on rollout API: specify min_samples, gate_sli, rollback_condition, and manual_approval flag. this makes automation safe.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: applied canary policy graduated-throttle on prod-canary at 1725010075; monitoring hooks active.
zoe_pm: action items: marco to spec flag API + policy engine, nina to finalize telemetry + AB contract, dave to write runbook and automation alerts, ella to draft privacy/legal language, larry to prepare comms. goal: spec doc by Thu EOD, dry-run Thursday on internal beta. add any missing acceptance metrics here. :white_check_mark:
